faction_endings: open the tithe-houses to the hungry
holy-house.door_fill: offended: whoever shaming the house in public wronged
holy-house.throughline: Because a Low Shrine priest, sincere, of the priestess's way wants what he believes the gods demand, he empties the tithe-houses' stores into the hungry's bowls and writes false receipts to hide it, to make the house feed people again; he feeds the outer ring from a tithe-house's door and calls it the house's duty, then the heart is cried down for shaming the house in public, and it comes to a head when his false receipts are found, the riders come to the Low Shrine for the grain, and the heart, who carried it, is named the thief.

faction_endings: make peace with the old heads
dueling.door_fill: captor: the headman of the village that lost the Society's first feud-settling bout's men; why taken: leverage on the guild
dueling.throughline: Because the headman of the village that lost the Society's first feud-settling bout wants a way out of ruin, he means to prove that bout was never fair, and take back the mill his village lost by it; he cries the Ring down in the taverns as a killers' yard, then his men take the heart and hold her, and it comes to a head when his village comes to the Ring for the old winners' blood, the heart's kin among them.

night-market.door_fill: framer: a Road Crews carter, the eldest of the carters who move the market; shield: *Protected*
night-market.throughline: Because a Road Crews carter, the eldest of the carters who move the market wants revenge, he is showing the toll men the trails one at a time, and turning the carters away, because years ago a Market crew hid a load in his son's cart and the son paid for it at a toll gate; he shows the toll men the plain door into Under the Market Road, then you are framed for holding back the take, and it comes to a head when a raid comes for Under the Market Road tonight with him riding along, and the whole market must move by dawn.

faction_endings: make the houses need us again
old-hands.door_fill: the stain: what a smuggling-cache keeper said of the player
old-hands.throughline: Because a smuggling-cache keeper wants a way out of ruin, he has made the quiet crossings a branch of the Walking Road, for Qotiro captives sold to the old houses, now that the houses' work is drying up, and it pays for half the syndicate; he has a steward who asked questions put out of a back room before the others, then you are put down a rank on his word, and it comes to a head when letters to three houses' rivals tell what the Old Hands carried for whom, naming the heart as the one who carried them.

writers.door_fill: captor: a Warden captain whose stretch of towers is failing

blow_detail.how: taken in a fight by a lord

writers.throughline: Because a Warden captain whose stretch of towers is failing wants a way out of ruin, he has the survey camps' edge readings redrawn to put the green a mile nearer the towns, so frightened lords will pay for his wall; he closes a survey camp at the green's edge and keeps its journals, then members are taken in a fight by his men, and it comes to a head when the heart must carry the camp's true readings out of Highcrossing, with his men on every road.

lantern.door_fill: cargo: the player; pursuer: the crown's recruiter for one march's men
lantern.throughline: Because the crown's recruiter for one march wants more power, he buys the march's chapter contracts through go-betweens, so those chapters stand wherever the march's muster needs them. He acts through the march's magistrate and muster, **never a Throne edict or war writ**. (Never states that the Throne is hollow.); he buys the chapter house's captain into his own service in front of its board, then his men hold you in a lord's cells, and it comes to a head when he calls in the chapter house's debts, and its chapter is held at Lanternhall to work them off, the heart's kin among them.
